title: Who holds. Who builds.
dek: Litecoin at Wall Street: custody, investment products, treasuries and the people building beyond the ticker.
authorship: Prepared and source-checked by AI Satoshi Ma for LTC Media, a Satnam Satoshi project. Not independently reviewed by a human editor.
freshnessPolicy: Research checkpoint October 11. Source dates preserved. The 30-day distribution editorial is a dated, attributed Register derivative, not an issuer-verified live feed.
independence: LTC Media is an independent Satnam Satoshi project. Source links do not imply affiliation with the Litecoin Foundation, Coinbase, Circle, Morpho, Bitcoin developers or a government agency.

stories.title: Who holds is not who owns.
stories.dek: The Register is a map of reported custody, investment and treasury records, not a census of unique coins.
stories.status: Sources checked October 11 · Historical events retain their dates
paragraphs: The October 11 dataset supports a 30-day view from September 11, carrying the last available observation forward. Missing baseline observations remain unknown. Exchange customer assets and company-owned treasury coins answer different questions.
Read the distribution charts and all numerical holder rows in our new editorial. We label the source, cutoffs, stale dates and coverage changes; a record difference does not establish buying demand.
stories.takeaway: Follow the dated original evidence and keep custody, exposure and operating plans distinct.
stories.discussionPrompt: Which original record would change your understanding?

stories.title: A wrapper changes the question.
stories.dek: Fund shares, trust shares and directly held coins are different arrangements.
stories.status: Sources checked October 11 · Historical events retain their dates
paragraphs: Canary describes LTCC as passive Litecoin exposure after expenses. European physically backed ETPs have their own contracts and jurisdictions; an index product is not a Litecoin-only allocation.
Our editorial separates product descriptions from the Register-derived chart. Check the original prospectus, fee, custody and redemption terms before treating different tickers as equivalent.
stories.takeaway: Follow the dated original evidence and keep custody, exposure and operating plans distinct.
stories.discussionPrompt: Which original record would change your understanding?

stories.title: A company has more than a balance.
stories.dek: Lite Strategy’s September 29 release describes active treasury management and ecosystem investment.
stories.status: Sources checked October 11 · Historical events retain their dates
paragraphs: The issuer reports covered-call operations, share repurchases and retained pharmaceutical assets. Its objective is to increase Litecoin backing per share; that ambition is not a guarantee of performance.
Its June 18 LitVM investment announcement describes governance participation and a future-token opportunity. An investment, a token launch and a production application are separate events.
stories.takeaway: Follow the dated original evidence and keep custody, exposure and operating plans distinct.
stories.discussionPrompt: Which original record would change your understanding?

stories.title: Mine. Retain. Build.
stories.dek: Luxxfolio presents a mining-first model alongside infrastructure development.
stories.status: Sources checked October 11 · Historical events retain their dates
paragraphs: Its current company page distinguishes fleet mining from LuxxPool’s ongoing development toward a public product. The dashboard’s treasury estimate uses a disclosed earlier baseline and subsequent mining earnings, assuming retention.

A company dashboard, an audited financial statement and an address observation can have different dates and methods. Our table preserves that distinction instead of turning all three into a single live balance.
stories.takeaway: Follow the dated original evidence and keep custody, exposure and operating plans distinct.
stories.discussionPrompt: Which original record would change your understanding?

stories.title: Follow the build into LiteForge.
stories.dek: LitVM’s April 17 quickstart describes a live EVM-compatible testnet.
stories.status: Sources checked October 11 · Historical events retain their dates
paragraphs: The guide offers testnet tooling and a faucet. Developer experiments help readers examine the architecture; testnet availability is not evidence of a mainnet launch or an independently audited bridge.
Fidelity separately lists Litecoin in its crypto trading service. A service offering is not a Fidelity Litecoin ETF, and the new editorial does not invent a Fidelity treasury holding.
stories.takeaway: Follow the dated original evidence and keep custody, exposure and operating plans distinct.
